# Defenders Hogwarts Guide

> Independent rules, strategy and buying guide for **Defenders of Hogwarts**, the Harry Potter board game by MinaLima. This site answers searches for "harry potter defenders rpg game".

The game people search as "harry potter defenders rpg game" is **Defenders of Hogwarts** — a physical tabletop board game by MinaLima (the design studio behind the Harry Potter films' graphic props), developed with designer David Waterman. It is not an online RPG.

Key facts (from the official rulebook, checked 2026-10-12):
- Players: 2–5 (one Dark Arts player vs 1–4 Hogwarts house players)
- Play time: ~90 minutes; Ages 13+; no official solo mode
- House win: one player personally collects two Defence Shields
- Dark Arts win: all three Progress Tokens + required pawns at the Location Card area simultaneously
- House Main Actions: Explore, Learn, Replenish; Dark Arts: Explore, Replenish
- Replenish (House) advances the Dark Arts Path; Library/Bonus/Event draws do not
- Base game: £75 recommended UK retail incl. VAT; original Kickstarter ran Jun 30 – Jul 23, 2026; base game shipping est. October 2026
- Different product from Harry Potter: Hogwarts Battle
